picks.name: Baltra
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- 96 and Forever is Baltra's own imprint. Dry research day across several label and artist checks (Rhythm Section, Nous'klaer Audio, Emma-Jean Thackray, DJ Paypal, Guedra Guedra, Afrikan Sciences, Sascha Funke all came up empty). Confirmed live on his own Bandcamp page.
picks.bio: "In the Afterglow" EP (reviewed by DJ Mag Jan 14, 2026, on his own label 96 and Forever) -- warm, melodic house/disco tracks including "Lost," "Keep Coming Back," "Twisted Ways," and "Echoes of Us."
picks.why_listen: Sun-warmed, disco-inflected house from a producer with a strong melodic signature -- good for a daytime or sunset-adjacent stretch of a set.
